name: Okonogi Shin'ya
source: [url=/c3103]Masaya's[/url] father. Had a debt of 50 million Yen on his name which built up over the years from his refusal to pay it because of his obsession with money. He divorced from his wife and ran away from Tsurugigaoka, shifting his huge debt onto Masaya.
